headline: Audacity 4 is a complete revamp of the ‘world’s most popular’ audio editor
summary: Audacity 4, a major update to the audio editor, is finally released. It features a redesigned logo, improved from earlier controversial versions. The update brings numerous promised improvements to the popular software.

headline: The White House is making arcade games racist
summary: The White House released policy-themed arcade games, some of which are deemed racist. Games mimic existing titles, potentially infringing on copyright. The Tetris Company has already responded negatively to the "Build the Wall" game.

headline: GoPro says it's still committed 'to your collective stoke'
summary: GoPro CEO Nick Woodman reassures customers that camera making is their "core DNA." This follows a proposed $285 million acquisition by Starman. Woodman claims the merger will strengthen GoPro's content creation tech development.

headline: Roland is getting into generative AI music with Melody Flip
summary: Roland introduces Melody Flip, its new generative AI music tool. Available as a DAW plug-in, it offers 250 themed "Palettes" of musical ideas. Users can generate melodies by inputting basic musical cues.

headline: 14 Predictions for the September 2026 Nintendo Direct and Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct
summary: IGN's Logan Plant shares predictions for upcoming Nintendo Directs. The article covers speculated announcements for the September 2026 event. It also includes predictions for the Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct.

headline: 'No One Puts Double Fine Out of Business Except for Me' — Tim Schafer Explains How He Kept Double Fine Afloat After Leaving Xbox
summary: Tim Schafer details how he kept Double Fine afloat post-Xbox divestment. The studio faced challenges after Xbox's massive restructuring efforts. Schafer, founder of the Psychonauts developer, expressed strong resolve.

headline: Wonder Woman Casting Rumors Heat Up as Fans Suspect James Gunn Secretly Picked Adria Arjona for the Role
summary: DC fans speculate Adria Arjona is the new Wonder Woman. Rumors intensified after Arjona posted a workout video ahead of "Man of Tomorrow." Fans suspect James Gunn has secretly cast her for the DCU role.

headline: gamescom Apologizes for Its Initial Response to Thefts, Promises Improved Security Measures
summary: gamescom issues a second apology for its handling of developer equipment thefts. The event faced criticism for its initial reaction to the security breaches. Organizers promise to implement improved security measures for future events.

headline: Cleveland police chief proud of force but being 'let down' by funding
summary: Cleveland police chief Victoria Fuller praises her force's efforts. She states the force is being "let down" by insufficient funding. Her comments follow a tragic A66 crash that killed seven, including two officers.

headline: 'I'd rather die than ring the police': Distrust and fear in Middlesbrough after A66 crash
summary: Middlesbrough residents express deep distrust and fear of the police. Violence has escalated in the town following a fatal A66 crash. Many residents feel unsafe and are hesitant to contact authorities.

headline: Reform promises to increase tax-free personal allowance to £15,000
summary: The Reform party pledges to raise the tax-free personal allowance to £15,000. They claim this tax cut will be funded by an £80bn reduction in public spending. This proposal aims to ease the tax burden on individuals.

headline: Lindsay Clancy murder trial has divided US on whether she's victim or criminal
summary: The Lindsay Clancy murder trial has sparked national debate in the US. Some view Clancy as a victim due to mental health struggles. Others argue that mental health issues do not excuse the murders.
